WORK_ENVIRONMENT_STATUS.json.note: One WEC safely carried Stage 5G, Stage 5H and Stage 5I through production proof, then correctly closes before the distinct physical milestone with no inherited predecessor decision.

workflow-job-logs.note: Exact Stage 5I Chromium jobs isolated two CI single-process lifecycle failures and proved the final separate-browser-process harness fix without weakening production code.

successor-entrypoint-coherence.note: Starter, deep SLE, bootstrap, graph/model/learning, current handoff, project state, next task and rolling prompt must all advance from r2 candidate language to r2 production-proven physical-acceptance routing together.

rjr-score-provenance-search.note: Fixed RJR-1 correctly remains 91 after Stage 5G/5H/5I, 15 exact-head successes, merge, 15 main-push successes, burn-in and complete deployment proof because those do not satisfy the explicit physical-device gap.

capability-secret-redaction.note: Stage 5I converts the unavoidable physical acceptance into sanitized JSON with a one-way session fingerprint, avoiding durable raw capability/account/device/rivalry identifiers.

pr194-exact-head-publication.note: Freeze one exact PR194 head, require all 15 families and zero review threads, expected-head merge, all 15 main-push families, two burn-in journeys and complete deployed-site smoke before calling r2 production-proven.

pr196-physical-evidence-validator.note: A physical-evidence validator needs a closed schema, normalized forbidden authority-key detection and non-echoing failures; passing remains a zero-credit candidate until genuine device/network facts are accepted.

local-workflow-and-server-lifecycle-safe.note: Local all-workflow replay must defer every authenticated production Rules publication block, and a self-contained browser preflight must own and terminate the direct server process so repeated runs cannot leak the port.

sessionMetrics.deepFallbackReason: Exact PR192/193/194 runtime, workflow and deployment evidence plus WEC/SLE authority were needed to exhaust automation without inflating RJR and to make the final physical step privacy-safe.
sessionMetrics.routeFailureCluster: Stage 5I Chromium single-process behavior invalidated two sequential context-isolation assumptions; separate browser processes resolved the harness issue without production changes.
sessionMetrics.ciTriageLesson: When the production contract is sound but Chromium dies during context lifecycle, isolate the browser runtime behavior before changing application semantics. Preserve every privacy and storage assertion.
sessionMetrics.productionEvidenceLesson: Exact-head green plus merge is insufficient: r2 became production-proven only after all main-push families, two burn-in journeys, every deployed runtime byte and the complete deployed journey passed.
sessionMetrics.authorityLesson: Automation can harden and instrument the remaining gap but cannot be relabeled as two physical devices/two independent networks. Stop at the clean production boundary and hand the genuine physical evidence milestone to a fresh WEC.

sessionMetrics.deepFallbackReason: The PR195 starter, live PR196 workflow/review state, exact WEC transition rules and repository-wide authority contracts were needed to automate the final evidence boundary without inflating RJR.
sessionMetrics.privacyLesson: Closed schemas must reject both unknown fields and normalized aliases of raw authority keys, and error output must never echo rejected values.
sessionMetrics.processLesson: Own the direct static-server PID and verify consecutive preflight teardown; trapping an npm wrapper does not prove child cleanup.
sessionMetrics.authorityLesson: Seal at HANDOFF_AT_CHECKPOINT after the corrected PR package; a fresh successor finishes final-head publication before requesting physical evidence.

latestLesson.lesson: Treat validation automation, publication proof and physical capability evidence separately. PR196's initial head passed all 15 families, but its two valid review findings required a corrected sealed head and a fresh exact-head cycle. The successor finishes that publication first, then performs one sanitized genuine physical acceptance and reconciles RJR from evidence rather than process volume.
